rust_oracle: rust-oracle.jsonl — 21 cases via live Store::usable (rustc 1.98.1): categories not_installed/corrupt/json/not_consistency_verified + full text for deterministic messages
ordering: dir missing -> NotInstalled; manifest read fail/bound -> Corrupt(io)
sha256(manifest_bytes) != generation_id -> Corrupt verbatim 'manifest digest does not match directory identity'
manifest serde-struct stage (strictJson + field/type/unknown checks) -> Json; semantic inspect failure -> Corrupt
decision absent -> NotConsistencyVerified; decision serde/shape fail -> Corrupt; schema/generation_id mismatch -> Corrupt verbatim 'decision does not bind this generation'
manifest_sha256 mismatch or status != VERIFIED_COMPATIBLE -> NotConsistencyVerified
typed_boundary: DecisionArtifact: exact 10-field set, string fields, evaluated_at RFC3339, status enum VERIFIED_COMPATIBLE/NOT_VERIFIED/CONFLICT, reasons tagged {code,role?} known variants only, evidence_sha256 string|null, probes JSON value; surrogates reject (rej_surrogate_issuer)
bounds: manifest read <=1MiB (inspect enforces too); decision read <=1MiB; size checked pre-read
comparison_policy: verbatim full message for deterministic categories (not_installed, not_consistency_verified, digest/binding corrupt); kind + stable prefix where inner text embeds io/serde messages (documented text delta, same as NM-026)
real_gen2: committed manifest b8a0d7b9 + retained bytes copied into fixture root -> NotConsistencyVerified (no decision written, no proof inferred)
purity: read-only; no create/repair/activate/pin/retire; gate reads recorded decision only — does not authenticate issuer/provenance
out_of_scope: store integration, task scheduling, service/MCP, deploy, production readiness
